data.pane-semantics-expanded--pane-语义expanded:
Scenario	Behavior	Target extends the current right pane (/products → /products/42)	New pane slides in from the right; the old pane shifts left / 新 pane 右滑入，旧 pane 左移	Same branch, not a prefix (/products/41 → /products/42)	A leaf is appended to the stack; the viewport shows the last two panes, so the right pane updates in place / 栈上追加叶子；视口只显示最后两个 pane，右 pane 原地更新	Target location already visible	Focus that pane, no duplicate expansion (idempotent) / 聚焦该 pane，不重复展开（幂等）	pushReplacementNamed	The right pane is replaced in place / 右 pane 原地替换	Cross-tab	Switch tabs and rebuild that tab's stack from the URL / 切换 tab，并按 URL 重建该 tab 的栈	pop / maybePop	Collapse the rightmost pane; when the tab stack is exhausted, step toward the root / 收起最右 pane；tab 栈无栈可退时逐级向根退	
SlidingPanes only does 1/2 columns; three or more columns are out of scope for v0.1.0.SlidingPanes 只做单列 / 双列；三列及以上不在 v0.1.0 范围内。
data.cross-breakpoint-rebuilds--跨断点重建#Cross-b: Crossing the 840 boundary rebuilds page State (Navigator tree ↔ viewport tree). Keep persistent state in the URL, an external store, or a signal — not in page-local State — and read Caveats in the FAQ.跨越 840 边界会重建页面 State（Navigator 树 ↔ 视口树）。持久状态请放 URL、外部 store 或 signal，不要放在页面局部 State；详见 FAQ 的 Caveats。

data.scroll--focus-restoration--滚动与焦点恢复#Scrol:
ZeroRouter restores state across breakpoint crossings and browser history changes out of the box:ZeroRouter 默认即在跨断点与浏览器历史变化时恢复状态：
final myRouter = ZeroRouter(
  initialLocation: '/products',
  // Both default to `true`; opt out with `false`.
  // 二者默认均为 `true`；传 `false` 可关闭。
  restoreScrollOffset: true,
  restoreFocus: true,
  routes: [/* … */],
);
Scroll — each route's content is wrapped in PageStorage keyed by ZeroRouteState.restorationId (the location), so a ScrollView's offset survives. Give your scrollable PageStorageKey(state.restorationId) to make the restore explicit and stable.
滚动 —— 每个路由的内容以 ZeroRouteState.restorationId（即 location）为键包在 PageStorage 中，因此 ScrollView 的偏移得以保留。给可滚动组件加上 PageStorageKey(state.restorationId) 可让恢复更明确、稳定。
Focus — primary focus returns to the route that last held it after a pop or a handoff, so history navigation does not drop focus to the body.
焦点 —— pop 或交接后主焦点会回到上次持有它的路由，历史导航不会把焦点丢到 body。
ListView(
  key: PageStorageKey(ZeroRouteState.of(context).restorationId),
  children: [/* … */],
)

Installation — detailed installation methods / 详细安装方式
Usage — full usage guide / 完整使用指南

data: All verbs share their names and signatures with NavigatorState.所有导航动词与 NavigatorState 同名同签名。
data.verbs--动词表#Verbs / 动词表: Verb	Description	pushNamed(location)	Push; the returned future is completed by pop(result) / push；返回的 Future 由 pop(result) 完成	pushReplacementNamed(location)	Replace the top entry in place / 原地替换栈顶条目	pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(location, predicate)	Remove entries until predicate holds, then push / 移除条目直到 predicate 成立后 push	popAndPushNamed(location)	Pop the current entry and push / pop 当前条目并 push	pop([result])	Pop the top entry, completing its future with result / pop 栈顶条目，以 result 完成其 Future	maybePop([result])	Ask the top page's PopScope, then the route's onExit, then pop / 先问顶层页面 PopScope，再问路由 onExit，最后 pop	popFrom(context) / maybePopFrom(context)	Act on the layer enclosing context (dialog / sheet / page) / 作用于包裹 context 的层（dialog / sheet / page）	popUntil(predicate)	Pop until the top entry satisfies predicate / 持续 pop 直到栈顶满足 predicate	canPop	Whether a pop would remove something / pop 是否会移除某些内容
data.pop-semantics--pop-语义#Pop semantics / po:
maybePop()
  ├─ fullscreen overlay open → consult its onExit → pop the overlay
  ├─ tab stack deeper than root
  │    ├─ consult the top route's onExit (false → consume the request)
  │    ├─ compact / medium: the branch Navigator's maybePop (PopScope, local history)
  │    └─ expanded: the shell route's PopScope, then collapse the right pane
  └─ tab root
       ├─ consult the root route's onExit (false → consume, the app stays alive)
       ├─ the branch root / shell route's PopScope decides
       └─ nobody handles it → the app exits (SystemNavigator.pop)
The AppBar back button, the Android system back, the browser back button and Escape all flow through maybePop.AppBar 返回、Android 系统返回、浏览器返回与 Escape 都走 maybePop。
data.real-web-anchors--真实-web-锚点#Real web anc:
ZeroLink is a widget-level link. On the web you may want a genuine DOM <a href> instead, so the browser can offer "open in new tab", "copy link address" and link previews. ZeroAnchor renders exactly that, while clicks still flow through the router (no full page reload).ZeroLink 是组件级链接。在 web 上你可能想要真正的 DOM <a href>，让浏览器能提供「在新标签中打开」「复制链接地址」与链接预览。ZeroAnchor 渲染的就是它，而点击依旧经由路由（不会整页刷新）。
ZeroAnchor(
  location: '/products/42',
  label: 'Product 42',
)
Notes / 说明：
ZeroAnchor takes a label (text), not a child widget — it maps to the anchor's textContent. Off-web platforms fall back to a plain ZeroLink, so the same code works everywhere.
ZeroAnchor 接收 label（文本）而非 child 组件——它对应锚点的 textContent。非 web 平台会回退为普通 ZeroLink，因此同一份代码各端通用。
Because navigation flows through the hash URL, an anchor always uses link / push semantics (the browser owns the history entry). Use ZeroLink for replacement / popAndPush.
由于导航经由 hash URL 流转，锚点始终使用链接 / push 语义（历史条目由浏览器掌管）。需要 replacement / popAndPush 请用 ZeroLink。
ZeroRouter.canonicalHref(location) returns the shareable hash URL for any location (#/products/42) — handy for "copy link" buttons and previews, including nested deep links such as #/settings/profile.
ZeroRouter.canonicalHref(location) 返回任意 location 的可分享 hash URL（#/products/42）——适合「复制链接」按钮与预览，嵌套深链（如 #/settings/profile）同样适用。
data.browser-back-on-the-web--web-浏览器返回#Brows: In-app navigation pushes a history entry (history.pushState); browser back / forward feeds a new location into the same pipeline, which rebuilds the stacks from the URL. Back collapses the rightmost pane one level at a time.应用内导航会压入一条历史记录（history.pushState）；浏览器前进后退把新 location 送入同一条管道，按 URL 重建各栈。返回键逐级收起最右 pane。

data: Every screen must be in the route table so its URL can express it — that is why there is no non-named push(Route).每个页面都必须入表，URL 才能表达它——因此没有非命名的 push(Route)。
data.structure--结构#Structure / 结构:
ZeroRouter(
  initialLocation: '/products',
  redirect: (location) => location == '/secret' ? '/login' : null,
  redirectLimit: 5,
  errorBuilder: (context, location) => Text('No route matches $location'),
  routes: [
    ZeroShell(
      builder: (context, shell, child) => /* … */,
      placeholder: const SizedBox.shrink(),
      tabs: [
        ZeroTab(initialLocation: '/products', placeholder: …, routes: [ /* … */ ]),
        ZeroTab(routes: [ /* … */ ]),
      ],
    ),
  ],
)
data.nested-shells--嵌套-shell#Nested shells /:
A ZeroRoute can host another ZeroShell via shell; its shellBuilder receives the nested shell widget as child (return it as-is to render the nested shell unchanged). Route tables therefore nest arbitrarily deep: each shell derives its own active tab and renders its own tabs / panes from the same flat location stack, so a deep link such as #/settings/profile restores both the outer and the nested tab.ZeroRoute 可通过 shell 承载另一个 ZeroShell，其 shellBuilder 会以嵌套 shell 组件作为 child 收到（原样返回即渲染该嵌套 shell）。因此路由表可任意深度嵌套：每个 shell 都从同一份扁平 location 栈推导自己的活动 tab 并渲染自身的 tabs / panes，#/settings/profile 这样的深链会同时恢复外层与内层 tab。
ZeroRoute(
  path: '/settings',
  shell: ZeroShell(
    builder: (context, shell, child) => /* inner rail / bar + child */,
    tabs: [
      ZeroTab(initialLocation: '/settings/profile', routes: [ /* … */ ]),
      ZeroTab(initialLocation: '/settings/account', routes: [ /* … */ ]),
    ],
  ),
  // `child` is the nested shell; return it as-is to render it unchanged.
  // `child` 即嵌套 shell；原样返回即渲染它。
  shellBuilder: (context, state, child) => child,
)
Two conventions to keep in mind / 需要留意的两点约定:
A hosted route uses shellBuilder instead of builder — the two are mutually exclusive.
被承载的路由使用 shellBuilder 而非 builder，二者互斥。
A nested tab's initialLocation is a full location (/settings/profile), while its route paths are authored relative to the host (/profile).
嵌套 tab 的 initialLocation 是完整 location（/settings/profile），而其路由路径相对宿主书写（/profile）。
data.zeroroute-parameters--zeroroute-参数#ZeroR: Parameter	Type	Description	path	String	Pattern relative to the parent; :param matches one segment / 相对父路径的 pattern；:param 匹配单个片段	name	String?	Name for namedLocation / 供 namedLocation 使用	builder	Widget Function(BuildContext, ZeroRouteState)	Page content / 页面内容	title	String Function(ZeroRouteState)?	Evaluated once at match time, no BuildContext / match 时求值一次，无 BuildContext	redirect	FutureOr<String?> Function(ZeroRouteState)?	Route-level redirect / 路由级重定向	onExit	FutureOr<bool> Function()?	Veto hook consulted before popping / pop 前询问的否决钩子	fullscreen	bool	Cover the shell at any width / 任何宽度下覆盖 shell	fullscreenDialog	bool	Present as a full-screen dialog / 以全屏对话框呈现	hidesBottomBarWhenPushed	bool	Hide the compact bottom bar (default true) / 隐藏 compact 底部栏（默认 true）	opaque	bool	Route opacity / 路由不透明度	barrierColor	Color?	Modal barrier color / 模态屏障颜色	barrierDismissible	bool	Tap the barrier to dismiss / 点击屏障关闭	transitionsBuilder	RouteTransitionsBuilder?	Custom transitions / 自定义转场	routes	List<ZeroRoute>	Nested routes / 嵌套路由	shell	ZeroShell?	Host a nested shell inside this route / 在本路由内承载嵌套 shell	shellBuilder	Widget Function(BuildContext, ZeroRouteState, Widget)?	Builder for a route that hosts [shell]; child is the nested shell / 承载 [shell] 的路由的 builder；child 为嵌套 shell
data.matching-rules--匹配规则#Matching rules / 匹配:
Child paths are relative to the parent: :id under /products matches /products/:id.
子路径相对父路径：/products 下的 :id 匹配 /products/:id。
The first match wins; a route that matches a prefix but has no matching child lets the next sibling try.
首个匹配获胜；匹配了前缀但子路由未匹配剩余部分时，交由下一个同级路由尝试。
:param matches exactly one path segment; the value lands in pathParameters.
:param 只匹配单个路径片段；取值进入 pathParameters。
Unmatched locations render errorBuilder (a default error page is used when omitted).
未匹配的 location 渲染 errorBuilder（省略时使用默认错误页）。
data.named-routes--命名路由#Named routes / 命名路由:
ZeroRoute(path: ':id', name: 'product', builder: …)
ZeroNav.of(context).namedLocation(
  'product',
  pathParameters: {'id': '42'},
  queryParameters: {'tab': 'specs'},
); // '/products/42?tab=specs'
Returns null for an unknown name.名称未知时返回 null。

data.imperative-zeronav--命令式#Imperative: Zero:
ZeroNav.of(context).open('/products/42');
ZeroNav.of(context).location;                    // '/products/42'
ZeroNav.of(context).canPop;                      // true when a pop would remove something
ZeroNav.of(context) must be called below a ZeroRouter; use ZeroNav.maybeOf(context) when the router is optional.ZeroNav.of(context) 必须在 ZeroRouter 之下调用；路由可选时用 ZeroNav.maybeOf(context)。
data.the-ontap-decision-flow--ontap-决策流#The o:
tap ZeroLink(location)
  │
  ├─ window width < 600   (compact)  → Navigator.push a new page
  ├─ window width 600–839 (medium)   → Navigator.push a new page (single column)
  └─ window width >= 840  (expanded) → expand / update the right pane
                                       └─ pane already visible → focus it (idempotent)
data.compact-chrome--compact-底部栏#Compact chro:
ZeroShell(
  builder: (context, shell, child) => shell.isCompact
      ? ZeroShellChrome(
          bottomNavigationBar: (context) => NavigationBar(
            selectedIndex: shell.currentIndex,
            onDestinationSelected: shell.goTab,
            destinations: const [ /* … */ ],
          ),
          child: child,
        )
      : Row(children: [NavigationRail(/* … */), Expanded(child: child)]),
  tabs: [ /* … */ ],
)
The bar is rendered inside branch pages, so a modal bottom sheet opened with useRootNavigator: false covers it, and the system back button closes the sheet first. Pushed pages hide the bar by default (hidesBottomBarWhenPushed: true, can be turned off per route).底部栏渲染进 branch 页面内部，因此 useRootNavigator: false 打开的 bottom sheet 可覆盖它，系统返回键先关闭 sheet。push 的页面默认隐藏底部栏（hidesBottomBarWhenPushed: true，可按路由关闭）。
data.fullscreen-overlays--全屏覆盖层#Fullscreen ov:
ZeroRoute(
  path: 'preview',
  fullscreen: true,          // covers the shell (including its chrome) at any width
  opaque: false,             // translucent
  barrierColor: Color(0x99000000),
  barrierDismissible: true,  // tap the barrier to dismiss
  builder: (context, state) => const PreviewPage(),
)
fullscreen / fullscreenDialog routes sit on a root navigator above the shell, so they cover the rail / bottom bar at every width.fullscreen / fullscreenDialog 路由位于 shell 之上的根 navigator，因此在任何宽度下都能覆盖 rail / 底部栏。

data.crossing-the-840-boundary-rebuilds-page-: The widget tree switches between the Navigator representation (compact / medium) and the viewport representation (expanded), so page State is rebuilt. Keep persistent state in the URL, an external store, or a signal — not in page-local State.组件树会在 Navigator 形态（compact / medium）与视口形态（expanded）之间切换，因此页面 State 会重建。持久状态请放 URL、外部 store 或 signal，不要放在页面局部 State。
data.why-does-a-bottom-sheet-opened-with-user: The bottom bar is rendered inside the branch pages (via ZeroShellChrome), so a sheet inserted into the same (branch) navigator's overlay sits above it. The system back button closes the sheet first because the sheet registers a local history entry with that route.底部栏渲染进 branch 页面内部（通过 ZeroShellChrome），因此插入同一（branch）navigator overlay 的 sheet 位于其上方。系统返回键先关闭 sheet，因为 sheet 在该 route 上注册了局部历史条目。
data.why-does-pushing-another-tabs-root-route: Inside the same tab, pushNamed is a stack push, whatever the target: pushing a sibling root route (e.g. /cart while on /products) puts it on top of the current stack, and popping returns to /products. Only a different tab (or an external navigation — deep link, browser back) replaces the stack. The pushed root hides the compact bottom bar like any other pushed page (hidesBottomBarWhenPushed); set it to false to keep the chrome.在同一 tab 内，pushNamed 无论目标是什么都是栈式 push：push 一个兄弟根路由（如在 /products 上 push /cart）会叠到当前栈顶，pop 后回到 /products。只有切换到别的 tab（或外部导航——深链、浏览器返回）才会替换整个栈。被 push 的根路由与其它被 push 页面一样隐藏 compact 底部栏（hidesBottomBarWhenPushed）；设为 false 可保留 chrome。
data.why-is-my-router-level-redirect-not-re-r: When the platform reports the location the delegate already holds (the same hash, a re-delivered route), the router treats it as an echo and does nothing — that is what keeps in-app navigation from looping. After an external state change (sign-in, sign-out, a feature flag), call ZeroNav.of(context).refresh() (or ZeroRouterDelegate.refresh()) to force the redirect to re-run for the current location.当平台上报 delegate 已持有的 location（相同 hash、重复投递的 route）时，路由器视之为回声而不做任何处理——这正是应用内导航不回环的原因。外部状态变化（登录、登出、功能开关）之后，调用 ZeroNav.of(context).refresh()（或 ZeroRouterDelegate.refresh()）可强制对当前 location 重跑重定向。
data.why-the-hash-strategy-on-the-web--为什么-we: /#/products/42 works on GitHub Pages without a 404 fallback, and refresh, deep links and browser back all share the same location pipeline as in-app navigation. In-app navigation uses history.pushState (no hashchange echo); browser back / forward is observed via popstate / hashchange./#/products/42 在 GitHub Pages 上无需 404 fallback 即可工作，刷新、深链与浏览器返回都与应用内导航走同一条 location 管道。应用内导航使用 history.pushState（不会触发 hashchange 回环）；浏览器前进后退通过 popstate / hashchange 监听。
data.why-is-the-initial-platform-route-prefer: A deep link (https://host/#/products/42, an Android intent route, …) must win over the configured default, otherwise deep links would silently open the wrong screen. initialLocation only applies when the platform starts at / (or empty).深链（https://host/#/products/42、Android intent route 等）必须优先于配置的默认值，否则深链会静默打开错误的页面。只有平台以 /（或空）启动时才使用 initialLocation。
data.my-page-does-not-rebuild-when-the-locati:
ZeroNav.of(context).location is a build-time value. Subscribe with locationListenable for reactive UI:ZeroNav.of(context).location 是构建时取值。响应式 UI 请订阅 locationListenable：
ValueListenableBuilder<String>(
  valueListenable: ZeroNav.of(context).locationListenable,
  builder: (context, location, child) => Text(location),
)
data.pushnamed-returns-a-future-that-never-co: By design: it is completed by pop(result), mirroring Navigator.pushNamed. Do not await it unless you intend to wait for the pop.这是刻意设计：它由 pop(result) 完成，与 Navigator.pushNamed 一致。除非打算等待 pop，否则不要 await 它。
data.can-i-push-a-route-that-is-not-in-the-ta: No. Every page must be in the table so its URL can express it (deep links, refresh, browser back). Unmatched locations render errorBuilder.不可以。每个页面都必须入表，URL 才能表达它（深链、刷新、浏览器返回）。未匹配的 location 渲染 errorBuilder。
data.why-does-the-system-back-button-sometime: At a tab root, maybePop is a no-op; the request then reaches the branch root / shell route's PopScope, and only an unhandled request exits the app. A PopScope(canPop: false) on the shell (or a route onExit returning false) deliberately keeps the app alive.在 tab 根处 maybePop 为 no-op；请求随后到达 branch root / shell route 的 PopScope，只有无人处理的请求才会退出应用。shell 上的 PopScope(canPop: false)（或路由 onExit 返回 false）会刻意让应用保持存活。
data.are-there-runtime-dependencies--有运行时依赖吗#: None. The plugin is pure Dart and uses only ValueNotifier / InheritedWidget (plus dart:js_interop on the web for the hash strategy).没有。本插件为纯 Dart，仅使用 ValueNotifier / InheritedWidget（Web 上为 hash 策略额外使用 dart:js_interop）。

/Layout-Without-Router.title: Layout Without Router / 脱离路由使用布局

data: SlidingPanes, SlidingPane and Breadcrumbs are public widgets usable on their own — you do not need a ZeroRouter for a two-column layout.SlidingPanes、SlidingPane 与 Breadcrumbs 均为公开组件，可单独使用——双列布局无需引入 ZeroRouter。
data.slidingpanes--双列滑动布局#SlidingPanes / 双列滑动:
SlidingPanes(
  children: [masterPane, detailPane],
  leftPaneFraction: 0.4,                     // 0.15 – 0.85
  slideDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 280),
  slideCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
  resizeHandleWidth: 4,
  resizeHandleBuilder: (context, isHovered) => const SizedBox(width: 4),
  paneBuilder: (context, pane, isLeft) => Card(child: pane),
  onLeftPaneFractionChanged: (fraction) => …,        // per drag frame / 逐帧
  onLeftPaneFractionDragEnd: (fraction) => …,        // once per drag / 每轮拖拽一次
)
One child → a single column; two children → master-detail.
一个子组件为单列；两个为 master-detail。
Growing from one to two children slides the detail in from the side set by side while the master yields the opposite side; shrinking reverses the animation.
从 1 个变为 2 个时 detail 从 side 指定的一侧滑入、master 让出相反一侧；变回 1 个时动画反向。
Pass a placeholder to fill the detail column while there is a single child (an empty-detail hint). Keep it free of a Key — the second child's key is how the layout tells an expand / collapse from a plain rebuild.
传入 placeholder 可在只有一个子组件时填充 detail 列（空详情提示）。请勿为其设置 Key——布局通过第二个 child 的键区分展开 / 收起与普通重建。
When the master is replaced while two columns show (give the children stable keys to opt in), the viewport slides left by one column: the replaced master exits on its side, the new pair slides in from the detail side. A pop (the old master becomes the new detail) slides it back. Replacing only the detail updates in place.
双列展示期间 master 被替换时（为 children 提供稳定键即可启用），视口整体左移一列：被替换的 master 向自己一侧退出，新的一对从 detail 一侧滑入。pop（旧 master 成为新 detail）则反向移回。仅替换 detail 时原地更新。
The detail expands to the right by default (side: SlidingPanesSide.right, master on the left). Set side: SlidingPanesSide.left to mirror the layout — master on the right, detail slides in from the left.
默认 detail 向右展开（side: SlidingPanesSide.right，master 在左）。设 side: SlidingPanesSide.left 可镜像布局——master 在右、detail 从左滑入。
The default paneBuilder renders a card when the pane is wide and a flat surface when narrow.
默认 paneBuilder：pane 较宽时呈现为卡片，较窄时保持扁平。
Drag the resize handle to change leftPaneFraction.
onLeftPaneFractionChanged streams per frame; onLeftPaneFractionDragEnd
fires once with the final fraction (the commit point).
拖拽分割线调整 leftPaneFraction。onLeftPaneFractionChanged 逐帧回调；
onLeftPaneFractionDragEnd 只触发一次并带最终比例（提交点）。
SlidingPanes(
  side: SlidingPanesSide.left,   // master on the right, detail from the left
  maxLeftPaneWidth: 360,         // stop growing on ultra-wide windows
  children: [masterPane, detailPane],
)
leftPaneFraction scales the master pane with the window (0.15 – 0.85);
maxLeftPaneWidth optionally caps it in pixels, so on an ultra-wide window the
detail pane absorbs the remainder instead of both columns stretching. Dragging
the resize handle respects the ceiling too.leftPaneFraction 让 master pane 随窗口缩放（0.15 – 0.85）；maxLeftPaneWidth
可用像素为其设上限，这样在超宽窗口上由 detail pane 吸收剩余空间，而不是两栏
一起被拉宽。拖拽分割线同样受该上限约束。With the router, set paneSide on ZeroRouter (or drive it live with paneSideListenable) to flip the expanded layout at runtime, and leftPaneFraction / maxLeftPaneWidth to control the split.配合路由时，在 ZeroRouter 上设置 paneSide（或用 paneSideListenable 实时驱动）切换展开方向，并用 leftPaneFraction / maxLeftPaneWidth 控制分栏比例。

data.breadcrumbs--面包屑栏#Breadcrumbs / 面包屑栏:
Breadcrumbs(
  items: ['/products', '/products/42'],
  onNavigate: (index) => popTo(index),
  separator: '›',
)
An InkWell + Text row that reports the tapped index; it brings its own transparent Material ancestor, so it works standalone.由 InkWell + Text 组成的一行，回调被点击的下标；自带透明 Material 祖先，可独立使用。

data: One tap. Every platform does the right thing.Adaptive navigation for Flutter: write one onTap and the plugin decides by window width whether to push a new page (mobile) or expand a sidebar pane (web and desktop). URL-addressable, deep-linkable, zero runtime dependencies.一套 onTap，任意平台都做出正确行为。Flutter 的自适应导航：只写一套 onTap，插件按窗口宽度决定移动端推入新页面、Web 与桌面端展开侧栏 pane。URL 可寻址、可深链、零运行时依赖。
